prior_result_disclosure.v1_failure: Run 33987778788 failed before scientific scoring because V1 incorrectly required filtered eligible score identities to themselves form an hourly-contiguous instrument clock.
prior_result_disclosure.reason_for_v2: Repair outage placement semantics only. Do not alter model, recovery arms, durations, block count, evaluation policies, thresholds, calibration or bootstrap because of an observed scientific result.

outage_semantics.clock: complete unique hourly window_end clock from the hash-pinned public feature table before target eligibility and purge filtering
outage_semantics.projection: after deterministic source-clock placement, hide genuinely observed cells of the specified modality only on eligible score-role rows whose issue time falls inside the interval
outage_semantics.not_claimed: This is a whole-modality forecast-input outage on the public feature-table issue clock; it does not reconstruct or reaggregate minute-scale raw instrument samples.

block_placement.candidate_range: all source-clock starts inside the frozen score-role time extent for which every required hourly source timestamp exists
block_placement.selection: nearest integer positions at the declared fractions of the ordered admissible-start list
block_placement.zero_support_rule: If a selected source-clock block maps to zero eligible score decisions or zero genuinely observed target-modality cells, report that block as non-evaluable with zero support; never select a replacement block.

cell_eligibility: hide only cells that were finite/observed before synthetic outage; pre-existing missing or structurally unavailable cells remain unavailable and are never counted as hidden truth

evaluation.primary: paired change in whole-score-role TSS at the frozen clean threshold after injecting all five predeclared source-clock outage blocks for that modality-duration scenario
secondary: probability absolute drift across score role
probability absolute drift on affected eligible rows
evaluation.bootstrap_unit: complete NEW-crossing event episode or predeclared quiet block
evaluation.selection_rule: report every modality x duration x recovery-arm scenario and every predeclared block regardless of result or support

promotion_rule: This development diagnostic can reject a recovery strategy or motivate a future validity/admission hypothesis. It cannot by itself validate an abstention threshold because the score identities and earlier random-missingness result have already been inspected.
claim_boundary: Development-only realism diagnostic. It cannot establish locked-test robustness, operational certification, physics advantage, named-competitor superiority, economic savings, award outcome or breakthrough.
